paper.title: StainFlow: Entity-Stain Tracking and Evidence Linking for Process Rewards in GUI Agents
paper.central_claim: StainFlow uses entity-stain tracking and dynamically linked visual evidence to deliver objective process rewards, improving AndroidWorldonlineRL3.2%relative and OGRBench completion accuracy1.8%relative.

gap.author_gap: Subjective milestone chains and rigid local windows produce poor long-range credit.
gap.checked_gap: Paper explicitly extends GUI-Critic-R1, ADMIRE and OS-Themis; residual is evidence selection and reward construction, not first dense GUI RL reward. Closest full texts are absent from fixed bundle, so their exact limitations remain author-reported.

lineage.relation: Sections2,4/AppB describe reused milestone/critic pipelines; this is author account, not independent predecessor audit.
Existing system-state outcome checkers already provide reliable final reward; proposed PRM supplies intermediate signals.

gap.residue: Align evidence around actually observed entities instead of prescribed plans and fixed windows.
gap.stakes: Alternative valid routes and delayed evidence are plausible practical failure axes.
gap.method_response: Entity stain recurrence and full-trajectory linked support construct mixed dense/discrete rewards.
gap.remaining_gap: Entity visibility and self-confidence remain heuristics, not objective credit; no reward hacking/path-invariance test or independent step labels.
